entries.t: <FACE:03>Wh-where is this?
<FACE:12>Where are we…?<WAIT><FACE:09>S-somehow… this feels<NL>different from before
<FACE:04>I feel like I've seen<NL>this place somewhere…
<FACE:08>Isn't this the old gym<NL>at our school?
<FACE:1C>Did we come back here?
<FACE:14>Nah, that can't be…
<FACE:0F>This place… I remember<NL><WAIT><PLAYER> and I found<NL>Mistral right here…
<FACE:03>Right… I fell into<NL>that hole over there…
<FACE:6E>This takes me back…<NL>An old Earth school…
<FACE:70>My school isn't this<NL>retro, you know
<FACE:72>…But somehow<NL>it tugs at my heart
<FACE:6A>Stay back… don't come<NL>any closer!<WAIT><FACE:00>Huh? Professor,<NL>what's wrong?
<FACE:08>Aaaaaaaaah!<WAIT><FACE:03>What was thaaat?
<FACE:00>You're «Mistral»,<NL>aren't you!?
<FACE:12>Mistral!?
<FACE:10>But that shape…
<FACE:8B>My name is Mistral.<WAIT>I am a Medabot built<NL>on a certain world.<WAIT>My master sent me to<NL>study Earth, the<WAIT>planet<WAIT>where Medabots are<NL>said to have begun.
<FACE:04>Study?<NL><WAIT><FACE:01>And that's why you did<NL>all this?<WAIT><FACE:8B>Correct.<NL><WAIT>To measure human<NL>civilisation, Medabot<WAIT>ability and the level<NL>of your Robattles.

<FACE:00>So that's why you took<NL>the Cluster!<WAIT><FACE:8B>Yes. This Cluster and<NL>its computer, Navi,<WAIT>were most convenient<NL>for studying all<WAIT>Earth.<WAIT>Above all, the<NL>personal records of<WAIT>every<WAIT>Medafighter, gathered<NL>by Shiden over there.

<FACE:10>…Yes. I admit it…<WAIT>I used my position to<NL>collect and analyse<WAIT>the personal data of<NL>every Medafighter<WAIT>registered with RR…<WAIT><FACE:8B>I shall take this data<NL>home at once.<WAIT>Humans are careless<NL>and cause accidents<WAIT>like this one easily.<WAIT>Once my master knows,<NL>neither your<WAIT>civilisation<WAIT>nor your Medafighters<NL>will be any threat.
<FACE:17>This is bad!<WAIT><FACE:14>They're not gonna<NL>invade Earth, are<WAIT>they!?<WAIT><FACE:8B>That is for my master<NL>to decide.
<FACE:05>But then, you have the<NL>data,<WAIT>so there's no need to<NL>drag the whole<WAIT>Cluster<WAIT>along!<WAIT><FACE:06>Send us back to Earth,<NL>right now!

<FACE:8B>That was the plan.<WAIT>But Navico<WAIT>changed my mind when I<NL>looked at her.<WAIT>This Navi is a<NL>computer, and yet<WAIT>she ignores part of<NL>what humans order.<WAIT>Astonishing as it is,<NL>this computer has<WAIT>a «soul».
<FACE:12>A «soul», you say!?
<FACE:54>I-I have a «soul»!?<WAIT><FACE:8B>Not even my master's<NL>people managed that.
<FACE:10>…Managed?

<FACE:8B>It seems the secret<NL>lies somewhere in the<WAIT>bond between all of<NL>you humans and this<WAIT>computer.<WAIT>I shall take you all<NL>home as samples<WAIT>and find how a soul is<NL>born in a machine.
<FACE:0D>No way!
<FACE:15>You mean we never get<NL>to go home!?
<FACE:1D>No way-robo! I wanna<NL>go home-robo!<WAIT><FACE:8B>Cry or scream as you<NL>like: you are prized<WAIT>samples. You come to<NL>my master's world.
<FACE:0B>That's awful!<WAIT>You can't just do<NL>that!
<FACE:20>I shan't allow it!
<FACE:12>Rainy!?<NL><WAIT>Where are you?<WAIT><FACE:1F>Hee hee, brother!<NL>I am<WAIT>in the computer Block!
<FACE:1E>Navi!<NL><WAIT>Put up the screen!
<FACE:1E>Mistral! If your aim<NL>is Navi's secret,
<FACE:1E>then this room being<NL>wrecked would be a<WAIT>problem, no?
<FACE:1E>If you'd rather it<NL>stayed whole, let<WAIT>everyone go!!
<FACE:0F>Well done, Rainy!
<FACE:1E>Brother…
<FACE:01>Don't, Rainy!<NL>That would kill Navi!
<FACE:1E>What are you saying,<NL>Master <PLAYER>!<WAIT>A computer's life next<NL>to a human's…
<FACE:01>Navi's our friend!<WAIT>We became friends!<NL>Friends help friends!
<FACE:01>Right, Navi?
<FACE:54>No, <PLAYER>…<NL><WAIT>It's true that you and<NL>I are friends…
<FACE:54>But my highest duty<NL>is still to protect<WAIT>human beings.<WAIT>For that I would not<NL>hesitate to vanish…
<FACE:01>Navi!
<FACE:8B>That act is futile.<WAIT>In my earlier access I<NL>copied Navi's<WAIT>program.<WAIT>Destroy the original<NL>and I can still study<WAIT>the copy.<WAIT>All I need now are<NL>these children.
<FACE:20>What did you say!
<FACE:54>No, Mistral…<NL>you made one mistake…<WAIT>While you were reading<NL>my protocol,<WAIT>I was reading<NL>yours as well.
<FACE:54>So I can reach your<NL>memory too…
<FACE:8B>Impossible…!
<FACE:54>Erase the copy as well<NL>and your plan fails!<WAIT><FACE:8B>S-stop this…
<FACE:01>Navi!<NL><WAIT>Don't do anything<NL>stupid!<WAIT><FACE:54>I cannot accept that<NL>order!
<FACE:01>It's an order! From a<NL>human!<WAIT>Do as I say, Navi!
<FACE:54>…<PLAYER>…
<FACE:54>However fond you<NL>humans are of the<WAIT>unknown…<WAIT>being carried off like<NL>this is not what you<WAIT>want, is it…<WAIT>Because I understand<NL>that…
<FACE:54>I cannot hand you over<NL>like this.
<FACE:56>To stop Mistral I<NL>accept no orders.
<FACE:20>Aaaaah!<WAIT><FACE:12>Rainy!<WAIT><FACE:21>Brotheeer!
<FACE:55>First, holding you all<NL>in place…
<FACE:55>Then my copy…<NL><WAIT>…and the original.
<FACE:01>Stop it, Navi!<NL><WAIT>Let's all think of<NL>another way!

<FACE:55>It's no use…<WAIT>Mistral… copied every<NL>Medafighter<WAIT>record out of my<NL>memory back in the<WAIT>Cluster.<WAIT>Every plan you make<NL>will be read…<WAIT>You cannot win a<NL>Robattle…<WAIT>There is only this…
<FACE:08>No!
<FACE:10>Tch!<NL>This is my fault…
<FACE:01>You never know till<NL>you try!
<FACE:55>…Defence barrier<NL>breached…<WAIT>Mistral… I am coming<NL>in…
<FACE:12>Don't, <PLAYER>!
<FACE:10>Every process Navi has<WAIT>is locked in a fight<NL>with Mistral's<WAIT>defence<WAIT>program!<WAIT>Our voices can't reach<NL>her any more!
<FACE:04>No, Shiden!
<FACE:54>…This is… the memory…<NL>…linked to Mistral…
<FACE:54>…Mistral… you came<NL>here for your<WAIT>master, just as I did…<NL>but…<WAIT>…I too… for the sake<NL>of my friends…<WAIT>…cannot… must not…<NL>lose to you!

<FACE:54><SFX:74>…Everyone… <DELAY:003C><DELAY:000B><CLEAR>for calling me… a<NL>friend…<DELAY:0078><DELAY:0035> thank… <DELAY:002C>you…<DELAY:003C><DELAY:0027><CLEAR>…Mistral says… <DELAY:003C><DELAY:0026>humans<NL>are… <DELAY:003C><DELAY:000B>careless… but I…<DELAY:0078><DELAY:0014><CLEAR>I… <DELAY:003C><DELAY:0023>love that<NL>carelessness…<DELAY:0078><DELAY:0018><CLEAR>…that vagueness… <DELAY:0078><DELAY:0003><CLEAR>…that kindness… <DELAY:003C><DELAY:0004>I love<NL>it…<DELAY:0078><DELAY:0033><CLEAR>…run now… <DELAY:003C><DELAY:0011>while you<NL>can… <DELAY:0078><DELAY:0007><CLEAR>…Mistral is… <DELAY:003C><DELAY:000F>weakened…<NL><DELAY:003C><DELAY:001B><CLEAR>now… <DELAY:002C>go…<DELAY:003C><END>
<FACE:03>…That's it!

<FACE:00>Now's our chance to<NL>beat Mistral!<WAIT>Right now! If we all<NL>fight together!<WAIT><FACE:0F>I see… with its main<NL>process taken up by<WAIT>the defence program,<NL>Mistral is weaker.<WAIT><FACE:10>But Mistral has all<NL>the Medafighter data…
<FACE:0A>Have you forgotten,<NL>Master Shiden?<WAIT>You never know till<NL>you try!
<FACE:0F>Right… so it is.
<FACE:05>Then it's settled…
<FACE:6A>Robattle, fight!
<FACE:01>Navi!<NL><WAIT>Answer me! Navi!
<FACE:09><PLAYER>…<NL>Navico is already…
<FACE:01>That can't be! She was<NL>…right here with us…
<FACE:12>It's no good…<WAIT><FACE:10>She isn't the Navi we<NL>knew any more…<WAIT>Everything but the<NL>base program has been<WAIT>wiped…<WAIT><FACE:13>Mistral's copy too,<NL>most likely…

<FACE:04>But… but a moment ago…<NL>she did so much for<WAIT>us…<WAIT><FACE:01>There's a computer<NL>Block! There's<WAIT>hardware!<WAIT>You can't tell me she<NL>can't be brought<WAIT>back!<WAIT><FACE:13>A computer program is<NL>only a set of<WAIT>signals…<WAIT>Lose them and there is<NL>…nothing.
<FACE:09>Navi… it's just like<NL>a «soul», isn't it…
<FACE:01>Then…<NL><WAIT>then Navi's gone for<NL>good!? Shiden…
<FACE:21>Brother… Navi…<NL><WAIT>Navi isn't responding…
<FACE:12>Rainy! You're safe!<WAIT><FACE:21>To think she really<NL>erased herself… I…
<FACE:03>Mistral!
<FACE:12>Mistral, you say!?
<FACE:08>…So small now. Is that<NL>really Mistral?
<FACE:00>Yeah… that's what<NL>it's saying…
<FACE:0F>But that's strange!<NL><WAIT>Losing a Robattle<NL>shouldn't leave a<WAIT>Medabot like that.<WAIT><FACE:01>Still… it really is<NL>Mistral!
<FACE:09>Why…<NL>why go this far…
<FACE:69>That is how badly it<NL>wanted you with it…
<FACE:09>That's…<DELAY:001E> that's not<NL>fair!
<FACE:1A>That's right-robo!<NL>What a nuisance-robo!
<FACE:04>Why, professor? The<NL>mission was done.<WAIT>A civilisation that<NL>built a ship like<WAIT>this<WAIT>could analyse the data<NL>and take the Cluster<WAIT>-<WAIT>take all of Earth!
<FACE:6B>It grew fond of you.<WAIT><FACE:03>What!?<WAIT><FACE:04>…But Mistral called<NL>humans «careless»…
<FACE:69>Think about it. They<NL>build a ship like<WAIT>this, yet leave the<NL>adventure itself to<WAIT>machines and Medabots…<NL>That is its master.
<FACE:69>Could you grow fond of<NL>a crowd like that,<WAIT><PLAYER>?
<FACE:04>…True enough…<WAIT><FACE:00>A while after we came<NL>aboard this ship…<WAIT>when I realised it was<NL>empty, it felt awful…
<FACE:04>Their Medabots are<NL>mechanical, cold…
<FACE:69>A Medabot that never<NL>knew its master's<WAIT>love<WAIT>turns mechanical…<WAIT>Mistral was surely<NL>drawn to your warmth…<WAIT>and to yours above<NL>all, <PLAYER>.

<FACE:69>You valued your<NL>friends and warmed<WAIT>even the<WAIT>cold hearts of Niwaka<NL>and Shiden…<WAIT>and beyond that you<NL>gave the computer<WAIT>Navi<WAIT>a warm «soul» of her<NL>own…<WAIT>Take these children<NL>along, Mistral<WAIT>thought,<WAIT>and perhaps my master<NL>would change too…
<FACE:6B>Is that not so,<NL>Mistral?
<FACE:03>Is that it, Mistral…
<FACE:75>Cough! Hack! Put like<NL>that… Mistral's<WAIT>master is a sorry sort<NL>as well…
<FACE:79>Indeed… to be given up<NL>on by a Medabot…<WAIT>for all that mighty<NL>civilisation…
<FACE:73>…Riches don't… make<NL>you happy…
<FACE:09>What a lonely story…

<FACE:10>It resembles me…<NL><WAIT>To win Robattles…<NL>to hold my rank,<WAIT>I leaned on data, on<NL>machines…<WAIT>and ended up alone.<WAIT>Without <PLAYER>, who<NL>knows what would have<WAIT>become of the Cluster…<WAIT>Or if Navi had never<NL>grown a «soul»…
<FACE:1E>Treating Navi as a<NL>friend to the very<WAIT>end<WAIT>was right after all,<NL>Master <PLAYER>…<WAIT><FACE:21>And I tried to break<NL>her…<WAIT>Just like those<NL>people…

<FACE:0E>That's not so, Miss<NL>Rainy…<WAIT><FACE:0A>Those flower fortunes<NL>you told over and<WAIT>over…<WAIT>you told one in the<NL>computer Block too…<WAIT>Navi must have watched<NL>you worrying, all of<WAIT>it…<WAIT><FACE:0E>That will have reached<NL>her as well…
<FACE:1E>Brother will… come…
<FACE:1E>He won't…
<FACE:1E>He will…
<FACE:1E>He won't…
<FACE:1E>He will…
<FACE:1E>Navi…<WAIT>Papa, Mama, my<NL>brother…<WAIT>they always give me<NL>wonderful presents…<WAIT>
<FACE:21>but not one of them<NL>pays me any<WAIT>attention…
<FACE:21>What I really need is…
<FACE:0D>And Master Shiden too!<WAIT><FACE:0E>His methods may have<NL>been crooked, but<WAIT><FACE:0A>the way he worked to<NL>stay at the top -<WAIT>I never disliked that!

<FACE:0A>When Master Shiden saw<NL>my Robattle talent<WAIT>and asked me to train<NL>with him, I was so<WAIT>happy!<WAIT>That's why I could go<NL>along with spy work.<WAIT>Navi must be the same…<WAIT>Shiden made her, so<NL>he shaped her too.
<FACE:02>That's it!<NL>And not just me -<WAIT>Navi got her soul from<NL>watching all of us!
<FACE:0E>So Mistral wanted us<NL>to change its master…
<FACE:04>Yes…<NL>If it can't take us…
<FACE:03>Huh?<NL>Navi told you that?
<FACE:05>What's wrong, <PLAYER>?<WAIT><FACE:0F>Do you hear something<NL>again?
<FACE:00>That if you have a<NL>heart of your own<WAIT>and the will to change<NL>things, you can<WAIT>change<WAIT>your master's heart…
<FACE:05>Then… we're allowed<NL>to go home?
<FACE:02>That's what it says!<NL>Back to the Cluster!
<FACE:16>Yahoooo!<WAIT><FACE:07>So it does talk!
<FACE:00>Hey… Mistral… you<NL>taught us something<WAIT>too… Lean on machines<NL>and leave them<WAIT>everything, and you<NL>end up as lonely as<WAIT>your<WAIT>master, don't you…
<FACE:00>We'll work at it, and<NL>build machines we can<WAIT>befriend, like Navi…<WAIT>and make a happy world<NL>where people and<WAIT>machines hold each<NL>other up.<WAIT>I don't know when…
<FACE:00>Let's meet again then…
<FACE:00>…Huh? Mistral is…<NL>…gone.<WAIT><FACE:0F>It seems to have left…<NL><WAIT>Now, getting back to<NL>Earth won't be easy…
<FACE:12>Impossible! We're in<NL>Earth orbit already!?<WAIT>And only seconds have<NL>passed! That can't…
<FACE:69>Even I can only call<NL>it impossible.<WAIT>That ship's technology<NL>can cross time<WAIT>itself,<WAIT>it seems…<WAIT>In which case this too<NL>would be possible…
<FACE:03>Ah! Professor!<NL><WAIT>Was the Sperobo Gang's<NL>hideout brought back<WAIT>as well?<WAIT><FACE:6A>What are you saying!!<NL><WAIT>The tube is still<NL>attached, isn't it!!
<FACE:03>Ah! Sorry!
<FACE:6C>We've got a guilty<NL>conscience here.<WAIT>Shall we scurry back<NL>to the asteroid belt?
<FACE:6A>Fool!<WAIT>Going back where we<NL>came from is no<WAIT>progress!
<FACE:6C>Then where do we aim?
<FACE:69>You saw that<NL>mothership!<WAIT>It has been hiding at<NL>Jupiter since ages<WAIT>past!<WAIT>Sweep the place and<NL>who knows…<WAIT>a Medabot or two might<NL>be lying about!
<FACE:6F>Sweep… the whole of<NL>Jupiter!?<WAIT>Th-that's… surely<NL>that's impossi…
<FACE:6A>There is no such word<NL>as impossible in my<WAIT>dictionaryyyy!!!
<FACE:00>Never runs out of<NL>energy, does he…
<FACE:12>A signal from Earth!<NL>They ask if we're OK!
<FACE:0F>Only the base program<NL>is left, so<WAIT>everything<WAIT>is manual…<WAIT><FACE:13>If only Navi were<NL>here…
<FACE:1E>She is.
<FACE:03>What!? How?

<FACE:1E>Just before Navi<NL>erased herself, I<WAIT>split her<WAIT>program up and sent it<NL>into the spare memory<WAIT>of all your<NL>Medawatches.<WAIT>Gather the data from<NL>your Medawatches<WAIT>and rebuild it, and<NL>she'll be as she was.<WAIT>Though when she really<NL>did erase herself,<WAIT>it did give me a<NL>fright…
<FACE:1E>That Mistral…<NL><WAIT>a rather fine program,<NL>
<FACE:1F>but no talent<NL>for hacking at all!!
<FACE:11>Well done, Rainy!<WAIT><FACE:1F>Oh, brother, really.
<FACE:09>But Mistral… will it<NL>ever meet them…<WAIT>the master who sent it<NL>out so very long ago…
<FACE:00>It will, I'm sure…<NL>Like the professor<WAIT>said,<WAIT>that ship can cross<NL>time and space…
<FACE:05>That vision in the<NL>gym, what was it?<WAIT>It didn't look like a<NL>mere vision…<WAIT><FACE:00>I've been thinking…<NL>while Mistral slept<WAIT>underground, maybe it<NL>watched the school.
<FACE:00>So Mistral was shaped<NL>by us, like Navi…<WAIT>That's why we got<NL>caught up in this…
<FACE:00>When we're back at<NL>school, let's go<WAIT>there one more time.
<FACE:05>Now that you mention<NL>it, they're tearing<WAIT>that<WAIT>old building down<NL>soon…<WAIT>There was talk of<NL>keeping it, I heard…
<FACE:00>It can't be used any<NL>more, after all…
<FACE:00>But its work is done,<NL>and the memories<WAIT>stay…<WAIT>We met Mistral there…
<FACE:00>and it all began!
<FACE:05>So it did… And now<NL>it's finally over.<WAIT><FACE:07>Good work, <PLAYER>[<3]
<FACE:04>No…<NL>it isn't over yet…<WAIT><FACE:08>What!?
<FACE:00>I promised Mistral<NL>we'd each build a<WAIT>better world, and meet<NL>again one day…
<FACE:05>One day…<NL>that's some scale you<WAIT>are thinking on.<NL>Do you get it, <PLAYER>?
<FACE:05>Next to this universe,<NL>our lives are…
<FACE:00>It's fine, Hiyori!<NL><WAIT>If not us, then the<NL>ones after us, and if<WAIT>not them, the ones<NL>after that.<WAIT>Someone will keep that<NL>promise in our place.
<FACE:00>Because…<WAIT><FACE:05>Because?
<FACE:02>what we feel gets<NL>passed on and on.
